name: Elder Dinosaurs
description: Five ancient, untamable great dinosaurs that awaken with Orazca and answer Huatli's call.

description_citations.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
description_citations.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Through the Sun, Huatli senses the Elder Dinosaurs awaken and calls them to her.
timeline.quote: She called Elder Dinosaurs to her, and felt the ground tremble as they began to approach.
